provenance.instrument: Pittsburgh Zoning Code, Title 9, 912.08 Accessory Dwelling Unit and 912.04, as amended by Bill 2025-1545 (Ord. No. 31-2026)
provenance.status_detail: Enacted. The Legistar master report posted on eCode360 as Ord. No. 31-2026 reads Status: Passed Finally, Version 7, passed finally as amended 9-0 on 10/27/2026, Signed by the Mayor 10/29/2026, effective 10/29/2026. The Legistar web page header shows the same dates and enactment number 31, but its status field still reads Held In Council and its public history stops at 7/29/2026. The signed paper ordinance was not seen. Text read: attachment '2025-1545 VERSION 7 FINAL' (strikeouts checked) and the master report text.
checks: For an Administrator's Exception the applicant shows the standards are met with a plot plan, photos and data such as written approval of abutting owners (925.06.G.2)
In a side yard, a detached ADU may not sit closer to the side lot line than the house (925.06.G.2(a))
Converting an existing garage inside a setback needs no Administrator's Exception if it does not go further into the setback (912.08.C.5)
ADUs are exempt from the Residential Compatibility Standards of Chapter 916 (912.08.C.4)
Height over a detached garage counts the garage (912.08.C.3)
provenance.notes: Strikeouts in the final text were checked on the rendered pages. Struck from 912.08: the overlay district, the 30-day lease minimum, one per lot, owner on site, the deed restriction, and the parking exemption. Chapter 914 minimum parking schedule is replaced by a maximum-only schedule.

path.note: ADUs are permitted on any lot with a Residential, Community Center or Religious Assembly primary use. By right for internal, attached and garage conversion units, and detached units outside the side and rear yards.

detached_in_yard_path.section: 925.06.G.1(i), G.2 and G.3 as amended by Bill 2025-1545 Section 47
detached_in_yard_path.note: Detached ADUs in side or rear yards are listed as features allowed within setbacks by Administrator's Exception, except ADUs built above existing garages abutting a way. Reading: 912.04.B lets accessory structures sit 5 ft from the rear line, so the exception may matter only inside a required setback. Ask the Zoning Administrator. Written approval of abutting owners is named as an example of supporting data, not as a strict condition.

fallback_path.note: Not confirmed. The bill does not name a path for lots that fail the standards.

zoning_districts.note: Any lot whose primary use is Residential, Community Center or Religious Assembly.

building_types.note: The single-unit test in the old definition is struck.

min_lot_sqft.note: No ADU-specific minimum lot size. The old exemption from the district minimum lot size (old E.6) is struck, so the district minimum may still be applied to the lot.

types_allowed.note: Definition: within a primary structure, a detached structure, or within an existing accessory structure. C.3 and C.6 cover ADUs above a garage. 'attached' is read as part of the primary structure.

max_sqft.note: Definition: not greater than 1,000 square feet (800 struck).

setback_front_ft.note: Same as the primary front setback. See districts table. Planned and public realm districts (for example RP, UPR, EMI, the Downtown and Planned Unit Development districts) set standards by plan and are not mapped.

setback_side_ft.note: Same as the primary side setback. See districts table.

setback_rear_ft.note: Accessory structures: 5 ft from a rear lot line not on a way. Existing text, not amended.

setback_rear_alley_ft.note: 2 ft when the rear lot line is adjacent to a way.

max_building_coverage.note: No coverage row in the 903.03 tables.

short_term_rental_banned.note: The 30-day lease minimum for ADUs is struck. Other city short-term rental rules not reviewed.

max_adus.note: For ADUs accessory to a Residential use. No cap for Community Center or Religious Assembly (C.9).

spaces_required.note: Minimum parking schedule struck. New 914.02.A is a maximum parking schedule only.
